meta.title: Urgiin Bichig — Mongolian family tree
meta.description: Build your family tree together, preserve photos, voices and documents for generations, and learn Mongolian clan history and customs.

common.notFoundText: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or was moved.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

footer.about: A home for Mongolian family histories — built so that what our elders remember is not lost.
footer.privacyText: Trees are private to your family by default. Details of living people are never shown publicly.

landing.title: Your family's story, kept together for the generations to come
landing.subtitle: Build your family tree with relatives, keep old photos, voices and documents safe, and learn the history and customs of your clan.

tree.title: Interactive tree
tree.text: Add parents, partners, children and siblings with one click. Remarriage, adoption and half-siblings are handled correctly.

archive.title: Photos & documents
archive.text: Scan old black-and-white photos, certificates, medals and letters and tag the people in them.

stories.title: Voices of the elders
stories.text: Record stories straight from your phone and attach them to the person they are about.

culture.title: Clans & customs
culture.text: Clan histories, Tsagaan Sar and Naadam traditions, and a guide to the nine generations.

reminders.title: Never miss a day
reminders.text: Birthday, wedding and memorial reminders by email or push, with round jubilees highlighted.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.text: Family, friends or public — you choose. Living people's details stay within the family.

landing.nineTitle: Do you know your nine generations?
landing.nineText: Mongolians traditionally count nine generations: four above, yourself, and four below. Record them before the names are forgotten.
landing.proverb: Remember the ancestors, carry on the lineage
landing.proverbNote: Mongolian saying — «Өвөг дээдсээ дурсаж, үр удмаа өвлүүлье»

auth.devDescription: Clerk keys are not configured, so the app runs in development mode. Choose a demo account (created by the seed script) or enter any id.
auth.requiredText: You need an account to see your family trees.

createTree.title: Create a family tree
createTree.description: You will be the family admin and can invite relatives afterwards.
createTree.name: Tree name

family.label: Family
family.long: Only invited family members can see the tree. Editors and admins can change it.

friends.label: Friends
friends.long: Family members plus friends you approve can view the tree read-only.

public.label: Public
public.long: Anyone can view the tree — suitable for historical or well-known families.

dashboard.title: My family trees
dashboard.emptyText: Create your first family tree, or open an invitation link a relative sent you.

upcoming.emptyText: Add full birth and wedding dates to get reminders.

treeAccess.signInTitle: Sign in to view this tree
treeAccess.familyText: Only family members can see it. Ask a relative for an invitation link.
treeAccess.friendsText: You can ask the family admin to approve you as a friend (read-only).
treeAccess.requestSent: Your request was sent to the family admin.

canvas.layoutError: Could not lay out the tree.
canvas.emptyText: Add the first person — usually yourself or the oldest ancestor you know.
canvas.emptyViewer: The family hasn't added anyone yet.

addRelative.title: Add {relation} for {name}
addRelative.description: Create a new person or link someone already in the tree.
addRelative.needsParent: Add a parent first — siblings are linked through shared parents.

panel.redacted: Some details are hidden because this person is living.
panel.claimed: Your account is now linked to this person
panel.deleteText: Their relationships will be removed too. Media stays in the archive. This can't be undone.

upload.title: Upload to the family archive
upload.description: Photos, scanned documents, videos and audio. Large videos are uploaded in parts.
upload.limits: Photos up to 40 MB · documents 200 MB · audio 300 MB · video 4 GB
upload.start: Upload {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
upload.done: {n, plural, one {# file uploaded} other {# files uploaded}}

media.heading: Family archive
media.emptyText: Upload old photos, documents or record an elder's story.
media.title: Title
media.deleteText: It will be removed from the archive permanently.

recorder.title: Record an audio story
recorder.description: Ask an elder to tell a story and record it here. You can pause, listen back and re-record.
recorder.unsupported: Your browser can't record audio. You can upload an audio file instead.
recorder.storyDate: When was it recorded / what period is it about

stories.emptyText: Voices of the elders are the most precious part of a family archive.

profile.redacted: Some details of living people are only visible to family members.
profile.claimed: Your account is now linked to this person
profile.changePhotoText: Choose one of the photos this person is tagged in, or upload a new one.
profile.noMedia: No photos or documents tagged with this person yet.
profile.patronymicHint: Ovog — usually the father's given name
profile.contactsHint: Visible only to the person themselves and admins unless you allow all members.
profile.customHint: Anything else the family wants to remember — favourite horse, homeland, nickname origin…

timeline.heading: Family timeline
timeline.emptyText: Add birth, marriage and other dates to see the family's story over time.
timeline.jubileesText: Round anniversaries this year and next.
timeline.noJubilees: No round anniversaries this year or next.

jubilee.wedding_anniversary: {years, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} wedding anniversary in {year}

kinship.heading: What do I call them?
kinship.intro: Pick two people to see the Mongolian kinship term, worked out from your tree.
kinship.note: Terms follow common usage; regional variants exist.
kinship.generations: {n, plural, one {# generation} other {# generations}} recorded
kinship.empty: Add people to the tree first.

settings.membersOnly: Only members can see this page.
settings.name: Tree name
settings.livingNote: In every mode, exact birth dates, birthplaces and contacts of living people are hidden from non-members.
settings.deleteText: All people, relationships, photos and stories in this tree will be deleted permanently.
settings.removeConfirm: Remove this member from the tree?
settings.leaveConfirm: Leave this tree? You will need a new invitation to come back.
settings.lastAdmin: A tree needs at least one admin.

invites.linkPersonHint: When accepted, the account is linked to this person ("this is me").
invites.rateLimited: Too many invitations at once — wait a minute.
invites.shareText: Send the link or let a relative scan the QR code with their phone camera.

friends.emptyText: People who find your tree can ask to view it as friends.

reason.revoked: It was revoked by the family admin.

invitePage.linkedAs: You will be linked to {name} in the tree.
invitePage.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account to accept.

explore.title: Public family trees
explore.text: Historical and well-known families who chose to share their genealogy. Living people's details are always hidden.

notifications.title: Reminders & notifications
notifications.remindersText: Birthdays, memorial days and wedding anniversaries from all your trees.

pushError.denied: Notifications are blocked in the browser settings.
pushError.not_configured: Push notifications aren't configured on the server yet.

notifications.timezoneHint: Reminders are sent around 8:00 in this time zone.

culture.title: Mongolian clans, customs and genealogy
culture.intro: Learn where your clan comes from, how to keep the customs, and how to count and name your relatives.
culture.clansIntro: Short histories of Mongolian clans (ovog). Link people in your tree to a clan from their profile.
culture.kinshipTitle: What do I call this relative?
culture.kinshipText: Build a chain like “father → older brother → son” and get the Mongolian term.
culture.clanNote: These are short overviews. Families often keep their own traditions about their clan — record yours in your tree.

kinshipBuilder.title: What do I call this relative?
kinshipBuilder.intro: Build the path from you to the relative, step by step, and see the Mongolian kinship term.
kinshipBuilder.ownTree: Want this for your real family?
kinshipBuilder.ownTreeLink: Use the Kinship tab of your tree.
